reasons: The Datadog query sum:system.net.bytes_rcvd measures bytes received, but the candidate uses system.network.packets, which counts packets ({packets}). Different quantity and unit.
The candidate selects system_network_direction="receive" on the packets metric. Filtering packets by direction does not produce received bytes.

A byte-based OTel counterpart (system.network.io filtered to receive) would be the expected mapping if it is defined and present in the dataset; it is not among the supplied definitions, so the correct metric should be verified before translating.
Aggregation (sum with no grouping) and the rate over a monotonic sum match the Datadog intent, but they do not rescue the wrong metric.
